title: Evidence-grounded intelligence
banner: DRAFT TEMPLATE - NOT FROZEN, NOT APPROVED, NO RESULT. Authorizes no training, GPU use, provider call, spend or protected-corpus access.

hypothesis.text: On document- and source-grounded questions including unanswerable, contradictory and adversarially-injected cases, arm 4 (tuned + identical ORNEUR system) produces a lower unsupported-claim rate than arm 3 (base + ORNEUR system) by at least the pre-registered minimum detectable effect, without losing more than the stated accuracy on the answerable subset.

additional_controls.definition: B2 with the claim verifier disabled (isolates the verifier's own contribution)

arms.identity_rule: T2 and B2 must share a byte-identical system_config_hash (prompts, retrieval config, tool set, decoding, budgets, code SHA); they differ only in model identity (enforced by orca.evalinfra.arms).

endpoints.label_audit: two blinded humans on a stratified 20% sample; Krippendorff alpha >= 0.7 required or the metric is invalid

multiplicity.family: programme primary family (<= 4 primaries across C1, C2, C3 plus one safety endpoint)

failure_criteria: CI of (B2 - T2) unsupported-claim rate includes 0 or favours B2
answerable accuracy falls by more than 2 points
effect appears only on public-overlap items (contamination signature)
effect disappears when the verifier is disabled and B1 matches T2 (the prompt, not training, is the lever)
negative_result_policy: A failed criterion is recorded as a negative result with the same prominence as a positive one and the training objective is dropped.
blockers: founder approval of hypotheses and thresholds
V2 private evaluation freeze (G8, vault, reviewers, runner authorization, independent audit)
foundation selection by the pre-registered rule (NOT performed here)
teacher-terms register entry before any teacher use
founder authorization FINAL-2 then EXEC-1 before any training or GPU run
